name: gaming
description: Install ANR FG frame generation into PC games through OptiScaler, with GPU spoofing and per-game recipes.

interface.shortDescription: Install ANR FG into a game.
interface.longDescription: Installs ANR FG (Apex Neural Rendering frame generation) into a PC game through OptiScaler and spoofs the GPU so the game offers the DLSS frame generation that ANR replaces. Covers Windows and Linux/Proton, keeps per-game spoof recipes with evidence labels, and looks up the OptiScaler wiki and ANR issues for games it does not know yet.
defaultPrompt: Install ANR frame generation into The Witcher 3.
Get DLSS frame gen working on my RTX 3080 with ANR.
